research.title: Image Classification Robustness Under Camera Degradations
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare image classifiers under simulated blur, sensor noise, and exposure shifts.
Evaluated augmentation settings using matched training configurations, examining classwise errors and confidence changes across clean and degraded images.

research.title: Pseudo-Label Selection for Semantic Segmentation
bullets: Planned supervised comparisons of confidence thresholds and class balancing for pseudo-label selection with guidance on experimental controls.
Implemented segmentation training configurations and examined boundary errors, separating effects of label availability from changes in pseudo-label filtering.

work.title: Inventory and Order Documentation
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed missing-item reports to the responsible staff.
Organized order paperwork, updated routine inventory logs, and coordinated handoffs of pending requests between shifts.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented a feature matching pipeline with descriptor comparison and robust homography estimation for aligning overlapping image pairs.
Compared matching filters under viewpoint and illumination changes, inspecting alignment residuals and failure cases involving repetitive textures.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Small Image Collections
bullets: Implemented frozen-feature and partial fine-tuning baselines for image classification, keeping preprocessing and evaluation splits consistent across configurations.
Compared validation behavior and classwise confusion under alternative augmentation settings, documenting errors associated with background clutter and visual similarity.

projects.title: Classical and Convolutional Image Denoising
bullets: Implemented median filtering, bilateral filtering, and a convolutional denoising baseline using paired clean images and synthetically corrupted inputs.
Compared reconstruction metrics and visual artifacts across noise conditions, examining tradeoffs between texture preservation and smoothing of flat regions.
